description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are about to attempt a Recall Knowledge check

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. Attempt the triggering Recall Knowledge check with legendary proficiency and your Intelligence modifier, regardless of the skill it would normally use and regardless of your proficiency in that skill. You are not consulting your own memory; you are consulting the Archive's, and it files everything the same way.

cinderfall.incomplete: Once/hour, cost 1 Bandwidth: attempt the triggering Recall Knowledge check with legendary proficiency and your Intelligence modifier, regardless of normal skill/proficiency. A same-skill, same-ability proficiency-rank bump alone would be buildable via `ActiveEffectLike` `mode:"upgrade"` on `system.skills.<slug>.rank` (the technique used for The Whole Shelf), but this card additionally swaps which ability score applies ('regardless of the skill it would normally use,' using Int instead) -- no rule element in `pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/` overrides which ability modifies an existing skill statistic, and none was found for this shape. Stacked with the Bandwidth cost. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
